verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents several first-party ways to operate it in natural language. Its official MCP server lets users drive the inbox and calendar from Claude or ChatGPT with single prompts to summarize, draft, send and schedule. In-app, Ask AI answers plain-English questions, writing and Auto Labels accept plain-language instructions, and agents can be built via chat. missing for 10: documented in-app natural-language commands that execute arbitrary actions (Ask AI is question-answering, and Cmd+K is a command palette, not shown to accept natural language), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
